```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT mb.component_id, mb.qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'AL4-120WAL24-0509'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cb.child_component_id, b.qty * cb.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = b.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = b.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom b
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = b.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-957-WHT-01956'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Start from the model's direct components
bom AS (
    SELECT
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'ER4-180OAK69-0166'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Expand assembly components recursively
    SELECT
        cb.child_component_id,
        bom.qty * CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM bom
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bom.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = bom.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bom.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bom.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'GEA-219-WAL-02353'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and find all ancestors through component BOM
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.is_assembly,
        1.0 AS qty_per_unit
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'LEG-806-BLK-02750'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        parent.component_id,
        parent.component_code,
        parent.is_assembly,
        pt.qty_per_unit * cb.qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM part_tree pt
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
        AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN component parent ON parent.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
),
-- Get all components that contain the part (directly or through sub-assemblies)
containing_components AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT component_id, qty_per_unit
    FROM part_tree
    WHERE component_id != (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'LEG-806-BLK-02750')
),
-- Get the item SKUs in the bundle
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = b.sku_id
    WHERE b.sku_code = 'BDL-DE-0328'
),
-- Map item SKUs to models
item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.bundle_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS sku_model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
),
-- Map models to components that contain the part
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        im.bundle_qty,
        im.sku_model_qty,
        mb.qty AS model_bom_qty,
        cc.qty_per_unit AS part_qty_in_component
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = im.model_id
        AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN containing_components cc ON cc.component_id = mb.component_id
)
SELECT SUM(bundle_qty * sku_model_qty * model_bom_qty * part_qty_in_component) AS total_units
FROM model_components;
```

```sql
    SELECT

    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

),
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_components AS (
    -- Find the part component ID for LEG-587-BLK-01170
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'LEG-587-BLK-01170'
      AND is_assembly = false
),
assembly_ancestors AS (
    -- Start from the part and walk up through component BOMs (assemblies containing this part)
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id AS component_id
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_components pc ON cb.child_component_id = pc.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION
    
    -- Recursively find higher-level assemblies
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN assembly_ancestors aa ON cb.child_component_id = aa.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
all_relevant_components AS (
    -- The part itself plus all assemblies that contain it (directly or indirectly)
    SELECT component_id FROM part_components
    UNION
    SELECT component_id FROM assembly_ancestors
),
relevant_models AS (
    -- Models that use any of these components directly in their BOM
    SELECT DISTINCT mb.model_id
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN all_relevant_components arc ON mb.component_id = arc.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

),

    -- Non-bundle SKUs that map to these models

    FROM sku_model sm

)
```

```sql
    SELECT model_id 
    FROM company_model 
    WHERE model_code = 'AE3-140BLK62-0159'
),

-- Get current model BOM components with their quantities
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty as model_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN target_model tm ON mb.model_id = tm.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Recursively explode all assemblies down to parts
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base case: direct components from model BOM that are parts
    SELECT 
        mc.component_id as part_id,
        mc.model_qty as total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON mc.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: direct components from model BOM that are assemblies
    -- (need to expand their children)
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id as part_id,
        mc.model_qty * cb.qty as total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON mc.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
    AND cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
    AND (SELECT is_assembly FROM component WHERE component_id = cb.child_component_id) = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: assemblies within assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id as part_id,
        ep.total_qty * cb.qty as total_qty
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN component c ON ep.part_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
    AND cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current date constant
current_date AS (SELECT DATE '2026-10-01' AS d),

-- First, get all item SKUs in the bundle BDL-CA-0316 with their quantities
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty AS bundle_item_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON bi.bundle_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.sku_code = 'BDL-CA-0316'
),

-- Get models for each item SKU (non-bundle SKUs map to models)
item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.bundle_item_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all components from models through component BOMs
-- Starting from model BOMs
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        im.item_sku_id,
        im.bundle_item_qty,
        im.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        im.bundle_item_qty * im.model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON im.model_id = mb.model_id
    CROSS JOIN current_date cd
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= cd.d AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR cd.d <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Recursive expansion through component BOMs
all_components AS (
    -- Base case: components directly from models
    SELECT 
        mc.component_id,
        mc.total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        ac.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM all_components ac
    JOIN component c ON ac.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ac.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    CROSS JOIN current_date cd
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= cd.d AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cd.d <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up quantities for the specific part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ac.total_qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM all_components ac
JOIN component c ON ac.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-680-BLK-01235'
  AND c.is_assembly = false
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all item SKUs in the bundle with their quantities
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty as bundle_item_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON bi.bundle_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.sku_code = 'BDL-JP-0043'
),
-- Get models for each item SKU with their quantities
item_models AS (
    SELECT sm.model_id, sm.qty as model_qty, bi.bundle_item_qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN bundle_items bi ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
),
-- Get top-level components from model BOMs
model_components AS (
    SELECT mb.component_id, mb.qty as component_qty, im.bundle_item_qty, im.model_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN item_models im ON mb.model_id = im.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all component BOMs
recursive_bom AS (
    -- Base: start with model components
    SELECT 
        mc.component_id,
        mc.component_qty * mc.model_qty * mc.bundle_item_qty as total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id,
        rb.total_qty * cb.qty
    FROM recursive_bom rb
    JOIN component_bom cb ON rb.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
      AND rb.component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE is_assembly = true)
),
-- Get all leaf parts with their quantities
all_parts AS (
    SELECT rb.component_id, rb.total_qty
    FROM recursive_bom rb
    JOIN component c ON rb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include model components that are already parts (not assemblies)
    SELECT mc.component_id, mc.component_qty * mc.model_qty * mc.bundle_item_qty as total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON mc.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
)
-- Sum quantities for the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) as total_units
FROM all_parts ap
JOIN component c ON ap.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'CAB-747-WHT-02876';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up to parent assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM component_bom cb
    WHERE cb.child_component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'FOO-998-OAK-02932')
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2024-12-31'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2024-01-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty * bt.qty,
        bt.level + 1
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON cb.child_component_id = bt.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2024-12-31'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2024-01-01')
),
-- Get all assembly components that contain the target part (directly or indirectly)
assemblies_with_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT parent_component_id AS assembly_id
    FROM bom_tree
),
-- Expand model BOM to find models that use these assemblies or the part directly
model_part_usage AS (
    -- Direct usage of the part in models
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.qty AS part_qty_per_model,
        mb.valid_from,
        mb.valid_to
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'FOO-998-OAK-02932')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Usage via assemblies
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.qty * bt.qty AS part_qty_per_model,
        mb.valid_from,
        mb.valid_to
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON mb.component_id = bt.parent_component_id
    WHERE bt.parent_component_id IN (SELECT assembly_id FROM assemblies_with_part)
),
-- Expand SKUs: non-bundle SKUs map to models, bundle SKUs contain item SKUs
sku_part_usage AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.qty * mpu.part_qty_per_model AS part_qty_per_sku,
        mpu.valid_from,
        mpu.valid_to
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN model_part_usage mpu ON sm.model_id = mpu.model_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: explode bundle items
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        bi.qty * sm.qty * mpu.part_qty_per_model AS part_qty_per_sku,
        mpu.valid_from,
        mpu.valid_to
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN model_part_usage mpu ON sm.model_id = mpu.model_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(ol.qty * spu.part_qty_per_sku) AS total_units_consumed
FROM order_line ol
JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN store s ON l.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN sku_part_usage spu ON l.sku_id = spu.sku_id
WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
  AND spu.valid_from <= o.order_date
  AND (spu.valid_to IS NULL OR spu.valid_to >= o.order_date);
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up to all ancestor components
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        cb.valid_from,
        cb.valid_to
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.component_code = 'CRO-590-WAL-00508'
      AND c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        cb.valid_from,
        cb.valid_to
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.parent_component_id
),
-- Get all model-component relationships with quantities, including recursive component expansion
model_parts AS (
    -- Direct model BOM to the target part
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty,
        mb.valid_from,
        mb.valid_to
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.component_code = 'CRO-590-WAL-00508'
      AND c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Model BOM to an assembly that contains the part
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        pt.child_component_id,
        mb.qty * pt.qty,
        CASE 
            WHEN mb.valid_from > pt.valid_from THEN mb.valid_from 
            ELSE pt.valid_from 
        END,
        CASE 
            WHEN mb.valid_to IS NULL AND pt.valid_to IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN mb.valid_to IS NULL THEN pt.valid_to
            WHEN pt.valid_to IS NULL THEN mb.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(mb.valid_to, pt.valid_to)
        END
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON mb.component_id = pt.parent_component_id
),
-- Get SKU to model mappings
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty
    FROM sku_model sm
),
-- Explode order lines to SKUs (including bundles)
order_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty,
        ol.listing_id,
        l.sku_id,
        o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
      AND YEAR(o.order_date) = 2025
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM sales_sku sku 
          WHERE sku.sku_id = l.sku_id AND sku.is_bundle = true
      )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty * bi.qty,
        ol.listing_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON l.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON sku.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
      AND YEAR(o.order_date) = 2025
      AND sku.is_bundle = true
)
-- Final calculation: sum quantities of the part consumed
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(os.qty * sm.qty * mp.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM order_skus os
JOIN sku_models sm ON os.sku_id = sm.sku_id
JOIN model_parts mp ON sm.model_id = mp.model_id
WHERE mp.valid_from <= os.order_date
  AND (mp.valid_to IS NULL OR os.order_date <= mp.valid_to);
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'MOT-147-BLK-00200'
      AND is_assembly = false
),
bom_edges AS (
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cb.qty,
        cb.valid_from,
        cb.valid_to
    FROM component_bom cb
),
model_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty,
        mb.valid_from,
        mb.valid_to
    FROM model_bom mb
),
-- Recursively expand component BOMs to find all parts and their quantities per parent component
component_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_component_id AS root_component_id,
        child_component_id AS part_component_id,
        qty AS total_qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM bom_edges
    WHERE child_component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM part_tree)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ce.root_component_id,
        be.child_component_id,
        ce.total_qty * be.qty,
        be.valid_from,
        be.valid_to
    FROM component_expanded ce
    JOIN bom_edges be ON ce.part_component_id = be.parent_component_id
    WHERE be.child_component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM part_tree)
),
-- Get all components (assemblies or parts) that contain the target part, with quantities
component_to_part AS (
    SELECT 
        root_component_id AS component_id,
        part_component_id,
        total_qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM component_expanded
    WHERE part_component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM part_tree)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        component_id,
        component_id AS part_component_id,
        1 AS total_qty,
        DATE '1900-01-01' AS valid_from,
        NULL AS valid_to
    FROM part_tree
),
-- Expand model BOMs to find all components, then join to component_to_part
model_to_part AS (
    SELECT 
        mp.model_id,
        ctp.part_component_id,
        mp.qty * ctp.total_qty AS total_qty,
        -- Use the more restrictive validity: both model BOM and component BOM must be valid
        GREATEST(mp.valid_from, ctp.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        LEAST(
            COALESCE(mp.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'),
            COALESCE(ctp.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
        ) AS valid_to
    FROM model_parts mp
    JOIN component_to_part ctp ON mp.component_id = ctp.component_id
    WHERE ctp.part_component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM part_tree)
),
-- Expand SKUs to models
sku_to_part AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        mtp.part_component_id,
        sm.qty * mtp.total_qty AS total_qty,
        mtp.valid_from,
        mtp.valid_to
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN model_to_part mtp ON sm.model_id = mtp.model_id
),
-- Expand bundles recursively
bundle_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id AS leaf_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        be.sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        be.total_qty * bi.qty
    FROM bundle_expanded be
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON be.leaf_sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
),
-- Get all leaf SKUs (non-bundle) with their quantities from bundles
bundle_leaves AS (
    SELECT 
        be.sku_id AS bundle_sku_id,
        be.leaf_sku_id,
        be.total_qty
    FROM bundle_expanded be
    WHERE be.leaf_sku_id NOT IN (SELECT bundle_sku_id FROM bundle_item)
),
-- Combine direct SKU-to-part and bundle SKU-to-part
all_sku_to_part AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.sku_id,
        sp.part_component_id,
        sp.total_qty,
        sp.valid_from,
        sp.valid_to
    FROM sku_to_part sp
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        bl.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sp.part_component_id,
        bl.total_qty * sp.total_qty AS total_qty,
        sp.valid_from,
        sp.valid_to
    FROM bundle_leaves bl
    JOIN sku_to_part sp ON bl.leaf_sku_id = sp.sku_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(ol.qty * astp.total_qty) AS total_units_consumed
FROM orders o
JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN all_sku_to_part astp ON l.sku_id = astp.sku_id
WHERE s.store_name = 'Wayfair-US-05'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023
  AND o.order_date >= astp.valid_from
  AND (astp.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= astp.valid_to)
  AND astp.part_component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM part_tree);
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all item SKUs and their model quantities from the bundle
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_item_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON bi.bundle_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.sku_code = 'BDL-DE-0328'
),
-- Get models for each item SKU with their quantities
item_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.bundle_item_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),
-- Get all components from model BOMs
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        im.bundle_item_qty,
        im.model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS component_qty
    FROM item_models im
    JOIN model_bom mb ON im.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all sub-assemblies
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base: start with model components
    SELECT 
        mc.bundle_item_qty,
        mc.model_qty,
        mc.component_id,
        CAST(mc.bundle_item_qty * mc.model_qty * mc.component_qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        ep.bundle_item_qty,
        ep.model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        CAST(ep.total_qty * cb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ep.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
      AND ep.component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE is_assembly = true)
),
-- Get only leaf parts (non-assemblies)
leaf_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ep.component_id,
        ep.total_qty
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN component c ON ep.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
),
-- Also need to include parts that were directly in model BOM (not through assembly)
direct_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.bundle_item_qty,
        mc.model_qty,
        mc.component_id,
        CAST(mc.bundle_item_qty * mc.model_qty * mc.component_qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON mc.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
)
-- Sum all quantities for the target part
SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT SUM(total_qty) FROM leaf_parts WHERE component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'LEG-806-BLK-02750')),
    0
) + COALESCE(
    (SELECT SUM(total_qty) FROM direct_parts WHERE component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'LEG-806-BLK-02750')),
    0
) AS total_part_quantity
```

```sql
        o.order_date,
        mpq.model_valid_from,
        mpq.model_valid_to,
        mpq.comp_valid_from,
        mpq.comp_valid_to
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND s.store_name = 'Amazon-US-00'
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON l.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sku.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN model_part_qty mpq ON sm.model_id = mpq.model_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND sku.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty * bi.qty AS order_qty,
        sm.qty AS sku_model_qty,
        mpq.part_qty_per_component,
        o.order_date,
        mpq.model_valid_from,
        mpq.model_valid_to,
        mpq.comp_valid_from,
        mpq.comp_valid_to
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND s.store_name = 'Amazon-US-00'
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku bundle_sku ON l.sku_id = bundle_sku.sku_id AND bundle_sku.is_bundle = true
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bundle_sku.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku item_sku ON bi.item_sku_id = item_sku.sku_id AND item_sku.is_bundle = false
    JOIN sku_model sm ON item_sku.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN model_part_qty mpq ON sm.model_id = mpq.model_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT 
    SUM(
        order_qty * 
        sku_model_qty * 
        part_qty_per_component
    ) AS total_units_consumed
FROM order_lines_expanded
WHERE 
    -- Check BOM validity on order date
    (model_valid_from IS NULL OR order_date >= model_valid_from)
    AND (model_valid_to IS NULL OR order_date <= model_valid_to)
    AND (comp_valid_from IS NULL OR order_date >= comp_valid_from)
    AND (comp_valid_to IS NULL OR order_date <= comp_valid_to);
```

```sql
    SELECT component_id

    WHERE component_code = 'TAB-874-OAK-02567' AND is_assembly = false

assembly_paths AS (
    -- Direct parent-child relationships where child is the target part
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id, cb.child_component_id, cb.qty, cb.valid_from, cb.valid_to
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find parents of parents
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id, cb.child_component_id, cb.qty, cb.valid_from, cb.valid_to
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN assembly_paths ap ON cb.child_component_id = ap.parent_component_id
),
-- Get all model-component relationships that lead to the part
model_part_links AS (
    -- Direct model to part
    SELECT mb.model_id, mb.component_id, mb.qty, mb.valid_from, mb.valid_to
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON mb.component_id = pt.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Model to assembly that contains part
    SELECT mb.model_id, ap.child_component_id, mb.qty * ap.qty, 
           CASE WHEN mb.valid_from > ap.valid_from THEN mb.valid_from ELSE ap.valid_from END,
           CASE 
               WHEN mb.valid_to IS NULL AND ap.valid_to IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN mb.valid_to IS NULL THEN ap.valid_to
               WHEN ap.valid_to IS NULL THEN mb.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(mb.valid_to, ap.valid_to)
           END
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN assembly_paths ap ON mb.component_id = ap.parent_component_id
),
```

```sql
        ccb.parent_component_id AS assembly_id,
        ccb.child_component_id AS part_id,
        ccb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_component_bom ccb

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        ap.assembly_id,
        ccb.child_component_id AS part_id,
        ap.total_qty * ccb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM assembly_parts ap
    JOIN current_component_bom ccb ON ap.part_id = ccb.parent_component_id
    WHERE ccb.parent_component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE is_assembly = true)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Expand each SKU (bundle or not) down to company models, multiplying quantities
sku_to_model AS (
    -- direct SKU -> model edges
    SELECT parent_code AS sku_code, child_code AS model_code, qty AS mult
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku' AND child_kind = 'model'
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    -- bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT b.parent_code AS sku_code, m.model_code, b.qty * m.mult
    FROM u_composition b
    JOIN sku_to_model m ON m.sku_code = b.child_code
    WHERE b.parent_kind = 'sku' AND b.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND b.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= b.valid_to)
),
-- Aggregate per SKU/model (sum over paths)
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT sku_code, model_code, SUM(mult) AS qty_per_unit
    FROM sku_to_model
    GROUP BY sku_code, model_code
),
-- Units sold per model in CA 2023 completed orders
sold AS (

    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = l.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model_qty sm ON sm.sku_code = sk.sku_code
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'CA'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
    GROUP BY sm.model_code
)

FROM sold
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the component_id for ASM-123-03577
target_component AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'ASM-123-03577'
),
-- Get all component BOM edges that are current as of 2026-10-01
current_component_bom AS (
    SELECT parent_component_id, child_component_id, qty
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),
-- Get all model BOM edges that are current as of 2026-10-01
current_model_bom AS (
    SELECT model_id, component_id, qty
    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
),
-- Recursive CTE: find all descendants of each component
-- Start from every assembly and find all parts/sub-assemblies inside it
component_descendants AS (
    -- Base case: direct children in component BOM
    SELECT 
        parent_component_id AS root_component_id,
        child_component_id AS descendant_component_id,
        qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_component_bom
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: go deeper into sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        cd.root_component_id,
        ccb.child_component_id AS descendant_component_id,
        cd.total_qty * ccb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM component_descendants cd
    JOIN current_component_bom ccb ON cd.descendant_component_id = ccb.parent_component_id
),
-- Find all components that contain ASM-123-03577 at any level
components_with_target AS (
    -- Direct containment: ASM-123-03577 is a child
    SELECT parent_component_id AS component_id
    FROM current_component_bom
    WHERE child_component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_component)
    
    UNION
    
    -- Indirect containment: ASM-123-03577 is a descendant
    SELECT root_component_id AS component_id
    FROM component_descendants
    WHERE descendant_component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_component)
),
-- Find all models that directly use ASM-123-03577 or any component containing it
models_with_target AS (
    -- Direct use in model BOM
    SELECT DISTINCT model_id
    FROM current_model_bom
    WHERE component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_component)
    
    UNION
    
    -- Use via component that contains target
    SELECT DISTINCT m.model_id
    FROM current_model_bom m
    JOIN components_with_target c ON m.component_id = c.component_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_id) AS model_count
FROM models_with_target
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the component_id for the part code
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'FAS-535-GRY-01684'
),

-- Get current component BOM edges (valid as of 2026-10-01)
current_component_bom AS (
    SELECT parent_component_id, child_component_id, qty
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

-- Get current model BOM edges
current_model_bom AS (
    SELECT model_id, component_id, qty
    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

-- Recursive expansion of component assemblies to find all parts at any level
component_parts AS (
    -- Base: direct children of assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_component_id as root_assembly_id,
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        cb.qty as total_qty
    FROM current_component_bom cb
    JOIN component parent ON parent.component_id = cb.parent_component_id AND parent.is_assembly = true
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand assemblies further
    SELECT 
        cp.root_assembly_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        cp.total_qty * cb.qty
    FROM component_parts cp
    JOIN current_component_bom cb ON cp.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component parent ON parent.component_id = cb.parent_component_id AND parent.is_assembly = true
),

-- All components that contain the target part (directly or through assembly)
assemblies_with_part AS (
    -- Assemblies that directly have the part in their BOM
    SELECT parent_component_id as assembly_id
    FROM current_component_bom
    WHERE child_component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_part)
    
    UNION
    
    -- Assemblies that have the part through recursive expansion
    SELECT root_assembly_id as assembly_id
    FROM component_parts
    WHERE component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_part)
),

-- All components (parts and assemblies) that are the target part or contain it
components_with_part AS (
    SELECT component_id FROM target_part
    UNION
    SELECT assembly_id FROM assemblies_with_part
),

-- Find all models that use any of these components
models_with_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT model_id
    FROM current_model_bom
    WHERE component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM components_with_part)
),

-- Find non-bundle SKUs that map to these models
non_bundle_skus_with_part AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sm.sku_id
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON sm.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id IN (SELECT model_id FROM models_with_part)
    AND sku.is_bundle = false
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) FROM non_bundle_skus_with_part
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
```
```sql
-- First, find all SKUs that directly map to the target model
```

```sql
    SELECT sm.sku_id, sm.qty as model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN company_model cm ON sm.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'AE5-140WAL72-0654'
),

-- Find all bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs mapping to the target model
bundle_skus AS (
    -- Bundles that directly contain SKUs mapping to the target model
    SELECT bi.bundle_sku_id, sm.sku_id as item_sku_id, bi.qty as bundle_item_qty, sm.qty as model_qty_per_item_sku
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN company_model cm ON sm.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'AE5-140WAL72-0654'
),

-- All SKUs that contribute to the target model, with their multipliers
all_contributing_skus AS (
    -- Direct SKUs: each sale of the SKU contributes model_qty_per_sku units of the model
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty_per_sku as multiplier
    FROM direct_skus
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: each sale of the bundle contributes bundle_item_qty * model_qty_per_item_sku units
    SELECT bundle_sku_id as sku_id, bundle_item_qty * model_qty_per_item_sku as multiplier
    FROM bundle_skus
),

-- Calculate total units sold
units_sold AS (
    SELECT SUM(ol.qty * acs.multiplier) as total_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN all_contributing_skus acs ON l.sku_id = acs.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
)

SELECT COALESCE(total_units, 0)::INT as total_units_sold
FROM units_sold;
```

```sql
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'VI1-140WHT65-0259'

    -- Base: SKUs that directly map to the model
    SELECT sm.sku_id as item_sku_id, sm.sku_id as root_sku_id, sm.qty as path_qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN company_model cm ON sm.model_id = cm.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'VI1-140WHT65-0259'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: bundles that contain these SKUs
    SELECT bi.bundle_sku_id, b.root_sku_id, bi.qty * b.path_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN bundle_skus b ON bi.item_sku_id = b.item_sku_id
    WHERE bi.bundle_sku_id != b.item_sku_id  -- avoid cycles
),
-- All SKUs that map to the target model, with their multiplier

    -- Direct mappings
```

```sql
       AND be.is_bundle = false
       AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE be.sku_id IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.root_qty,

        NULL AS sku_code,
        NULL AS is_bundle,
        be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_edges AS (
    SELECT
        parent_kind,
        parent_code,
        child_kind,
        child_code,
        qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM u_composition
),
explode_sku AS (
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024
),
-- Recursively expand SKU -> model -> component -> component
bom_paths AS (
    -- Anchor: SKU to model (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT
        e.sku_id,
        e.order_id,
        e.order_qty,
        e.order_date,
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.is_assembly,
        e.order_qty * ce.qty AS total_qty
    FROM explode_sku e
    JOIN u_composition ce
        ON ce.parent_kind = 'sku'
       AND ce.parent_code = e.sku_code
       AND ce.child_kind = 'model'
       AND ce.valid_from <= e.order_date
       AND (ce.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= ce.valid_to)
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = ce.child_code
    JOIN u_composition mc
        ON mc.parent_kind = 'model'
       AND mc.parent_code = m.model_code
       AND mc.child_kind = 'component'
       AND mc.valid_from <= e.order_date
       AND (mc.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= mc.valid_to)
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = mc.child_code
    WHERE e.is_bundle = false

    UNION ALL

    -- Anchor: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model -> component
    SELECT
        e.sku_id,
        e.order_id,
        e.order_qty,
        e.order_date,
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.is_assembly,
        e.order_qty * b.qty * im.qty * mc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM explode_sku e
    JOIN u_composition b
        ON b.parent_kind = 'sku'
       AND b.parent_code = e.sku_code
       AND b.child_kind = 'sku'
       AND b.valid_from <= e.order_date
       AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= b.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku item_sku ON item_sku.sku_code = b.child_code
    JOIN u_composition im
        ON im.parent_kind = 'sku'
       AND im.parent_code = item_sku.sku_code
       AND im.child_kind = 'model'
       AND im.valid_from <= e.order_date
       AND (im.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= im.valid_to)
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = im.child_code
    JOIN u_composition mc
        ON mc.parent_kind = 'model'
       AND mc.parent_code = m.model_code
       AND mc.child_kind = 'component'
       AND mc.valid_from <= e.order_date
       AND (mc.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= mc.valid_to)
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = mc.child_code
    WHERE e.is_bundle = true

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: assembly component -> child component
    SELECT
        bp.sku_id,
        bp.order_id,
        bp.order_qty,
        bp.order_date,
        bp.model_id,
        bp.model_code,
        child.component_id,
        child.component_code,
        child.is_assembly,
        bp.total_qty * cc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN u_composition cc
        ON cc.parent_kind = 'component'
       AND cc.parent_code = bp.component_code
       AND cc.child_kind = 'component'
       AND cc.valid_from <= bp.order_date
       AND (cc.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.order_date <= cc.valid_to)
    JOIN component child ON child.component_code = cc.child_code
    WHERE bp.is_assembly = true
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS units_consumed
FROM bom_paths
WHERE component_code = 'MOT-228-WAL-00998'
  AND is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
        ol.order_line_qty * sm.qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON ol.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sku.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sku.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand through bundle_item to get item SKUs, then their models
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku,
        ol.order_line_qty * bi.qty * sm.qty AS total_model_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku bundle_sku ON ol.sku_id = bundle_sku.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bundle_sku.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku item_sku ON bi.item_sku_id = item_sku.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON item_sku.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE bundle_sku.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get components from model BOM (valid on order date)
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.order_date,
        mb.component_id,
        es.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_component_qty
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN model_bom mb ON es.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= es.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR es.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Recursively explode assembly components through component BOM (valid on order date)
recursive_bom AS (
    -- Base case: components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        mc.order_id,
        mc.line_no,
        mc.order_date,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.total_component_qty AS qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        rb.order_id,
        rb.line_no,
        rb.order_date,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        rb.qty * cb.qty AS qty
    FROM recursive_bom rb
    JOIN component c ON rb.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= rb.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR rb.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum quantities for the specific part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rb.qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM recursive_bom rb
JOIN component c ON rb.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'LEG-407-OAK-00192'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders for Wayfair-US-05 in 2023
wayfair_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Wayfair-US-05'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_lines_with_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.is_bundle,
        sk.sku_code,
        wo.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN wayfair_orders wo ON ol.order_id = wo.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
),

-- Expand bundles to get the underlying item SKUs and their quantities
-- For non-bundles, this is just the SKU itself with qty 1
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        ols.order_id,
        ols.line_no,
        ols.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        ols.sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        ols.line_qty AS order_line_qty,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier,
        ols.order_date
    FROM order_lines_with_sku ols
    WHERE ols.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ols.order_id,
        ols.line_no,
        ols.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        ols.line_qty AS order_line_qty,
        bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier,
        ols.order_date
    FROM order_lines_with_sku ols
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ols.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ols.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map SKUs to company models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.original_sku_id,
        es.item_sku_id,
        es.order_line_qty,
        es.bundle_multiplier,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty,
        es.order_date
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total model quantities per order line (accounting for bundle expansion)
model_quantities AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        line_no,
        model_id,
        order_line_qty * bundle_multiplier * model_qty AS total_model_qty,
        order_date
    FROM sku_models
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode component BOMs
-- Start with model BOMs
component_explosion AS (
    -- Base: model components
    SELECT 
        mq.order_id,
        mq.line_no,
        mq.model_id AS parent_id,
        mb.component_id AS child_component_id,
        mq.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty,
        mq.order_date,
        1 AS level,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM model_quantities mq
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mq.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= mq.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mq.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: assembly components
    SELECT 
        ce.order_id,
        ce.line_no,
        ce.child_component_id AS parent_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        ce.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty,
        ce.order_date,
        ce.level + 1,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM component_explosion ce
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ce.child_component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE ce.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= ce.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR ce.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up all quantities for part MOT-147-BLK-00200

FROM component_explosion ce
JOIN component c ON ce.child_component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'MOT-147-BLK-00200'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the component_id for the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id 
    FROM component 
    WHERE component_code = 'FOO-998-OAK-02932'
),

-- Get store_id for Amazon-CA-14
target_store AS (
    SELECT store_id 
    FROM store 
    WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14'
),

-- Get all completed orders from target store in 2024
store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN target_store ts ON o.store_id = ts.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines with their SKU and quantity
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        so.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store_orders so ON ol.order_id = so.order_id
),

-- Resolve bundles to item SKUs with quantities
-- If SKU is a bundle, explode to bundle items; otherwise keep as-is
resolved_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.line_qty as order_line_qty,
        ol.sku_id as resolved_sku_id,
        1 as bundle_multiplier,
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs exploded to items
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.line_qty as order_line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id as resolved_sku_id,
        bi.qty as bundle_multiplier,
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get model quantities for each resolved SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.order_id,
        rs.order_line_qty,
        rs.bundle_multiplier,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty as model_qty,
        rs.order_date
    FROM resolved_skus rs
    JOIN sku_model sm ON rs.resolved_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total model units needed per order line: order_line_qty * bundle_multiplier * model_qty
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        model_id,
        order_line_qty * bundle_multiplier * model_qty as total_model_qty,
        order_date
    FROM sku_models
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode model BOM to components
-- Start with model BOM edges
model_bom_exploded AS (
    SELECT 
        mu.order_id,
        mu.order_date,
        mb.component_id as parent_id,
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mu.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS DOUBLE) as total_qty,
        1 as level
    FROM model_units mu
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mu.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= mu.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mu.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode component BOMs
    SELECT 
        mbe.order_id,
        mbe.order_date,
        cb.parent_component_id as parent_id,
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        CAST(mbe.total_qty * cb.qty AS DOUBLE) as total_qty,
        mbe.level + 1
    FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
    JOIN component_bom cb ON mbe.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= mbe.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mbe.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM component c WHERE c.component_id = mbe.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true)
),

-- Get all leaf parts (non-assembly components) from the explosion
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        mbe.order_id,
        mbe.order_date,
        mbe.component_id,
        mbe.total_qty
    FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
    JOIN component c ON mbe.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include direct model BOM components that are parts (level 1, not assemblies)
    SELECT 
        mu.order_id,
        mu.order_date,
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mu.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS DOUBLE) as total_qty
    FROM model_units mu
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mu.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
      AND mb.valid_from <= mu.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mu.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Sum quantities for the target part
target_consumption AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) as total_consumed
    FROM all_parts ap
    JOIN target_part tp ON ap.component_id = tp.component_id
)

SELECT CAST(total_consumed AS BIGINT) as units_consumed
FROM target_consumption
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for the store in 2025 with their SKUs
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty as order_line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
    AND o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),

-- Expand bundles to get underlying SKUs and their model mappings
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.qty * 1 as sku_qty  -- qty from order_line for non-bundle
    FROM order_lines ol
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_id as sku_id,
        ol.order_line_qty * bi.qty as sku_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get model quantities for each SKU
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Get all components from model BOMs with validity check
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.order_date,
        mb.component_id,
        sm.model_qty * mb.qty as total_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date 
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode component BOMs
-- Start with model components and recursively expand assemblies
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base: components from model BOMs
    SELECT 
        mc.order_id,
        mc.line_no,
        mc.order_date,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.total_qty as qty
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_date,
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        be.qty * cb.qty as qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN component c ON be.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
    AND cb.valid_from <= be.order_date
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
),

-- Get the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'CRO-590-WAL-00508'
    AND is_assembly = false
)

-- Sum up all quantities of the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.qty), 0) as total_consumed
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN target_part tp ON be.component_id = tp.component_id
```

```sql
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-JP-13'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Get order lines with SKU info, exploding bundle SKUs to their item SKUs
-- For non-bundle SKUs, keep as-is; for bundles, expand to item SKUs
exploded_lines AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.listing_id,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle,
        sk.sku_id AS resolved_sku_id,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to their items
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.listing_id,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle,
        bi.item_sku_id AS resolved_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON sk.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get models for each resolved SKU with their quantities
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        el.order_id,
        el.order_line_qty,
        el.bundle_multiplier,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM exploded_lines el
    JOIN sku_model sm ON el.resolved_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total units per model per order line: order_line_qty * bundle_multiplier * model_qty
model_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        SUM(sm.order_line_qty * sm.bundle_multiplier * sm.model_qty) AS total_model_qty
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN sku_models sm ON so.order_id = sm.order_id
    GROUP BY so.order_id, so.order_date, sm.model_id

    -- Base: model BOM edges

        md.order_id,
        md.order_date,
        md.model_id AS root_model_id,
        mb.component_id AS current_component_id,
        md.total_model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM model_demand md
    JOIN model_bom mb ON md.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= md.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR md.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: component BOM edges for assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_model_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS current_component_id,
        be.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN component c ON be.current_component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= be.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up all quantities for the target part

FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN component c ON be.current_component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'TAB-874-OAK-02567'
```

```sql
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14'
    AND o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
    AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Expand bundles: for each order line, get the underlying item SKUs and their quantities
-- If SKU is a bundle, explode to item SKUs. If not a bundle, keep as-is.
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map directly to models
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id as original_sku_id,
        ol.sku_id as item_sku_id,
        ol.order_line_qty as sku_qty  -- qty of this SKU in the order line
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: explode to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id as original_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        ol.order_line_qty * bi.qty as sku_qty  -- bundle qty * item qty within bundle
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map SKUs to models
sku_to_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.order_line_qty,
        es.order_date,
        es.original_sku_id,
        es.item_sku_id,
        es.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty as model_qty  -- total qty of this model needed
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Get model BOM components with validity check
model_bom_expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        stm.order_id,
        stm.line_no,
        stm.order_date,
        stm.model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty as bom_qty,
        stm.model_qty * mb.qty as total_component_qty
    FROM sku_to_models stm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON stm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= stm.order_date 
    AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR stm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode component BOMs
-- Start with components from model BOM
component_hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: components directly from model BOM
    SELECT 
        mbe.order_id,
        mbe.line_no,
        mbe.order_date,
        mbe.component_id,
        mbe.total_component_qty as qty,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.component_code,
        c.name
    FROM model_bom_expanded mbe
    JOIN component c ON mbe.component_id = c.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        ch.order_id,
        ch.line_no,
        ch.order_date,
        cb.child_component_id as component_id,
        ch.qty * cb.qty as qty,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.component_code,
        c.name
    FROM component_hierarchy ch
    JOIN component_bom cb ON ch.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE ch.is_assembly = true
    AND cb.valid_from <= ch.order_date 
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR ch.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up all quantities for the specific part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) as total_consumed
FROM component_hierarchy
WHERE is_assembly = false
AND component_code = 'MOT-228-WAL-00998'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders from Wayfair-JP-23 in 2023
wayfair_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),

-- Get all order lines with their SKUs and quantities
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        wo.order_id,
        wo.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty
    FROM wayfair_orders wo
    JOIN order_line ol ON wo.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),

-- Expand bundles: for bundle SKUs, get their item SKUs; for non-bundles, keep as-is
-- We need to handle nested bundles (bundle items can themselves be bundles)
-- First, identify all SKUs involved
sku_hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: direct order lines
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.line_qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.sku_id AS resolved_sku_id,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier,
        0 AS level
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand bundles
    SELECT 
        sh.order_id,
        sh.order_date,
        sh.sku_id,
        sh.order_line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id AS resolved_sku_id,
        sh.bundle_multiplier * bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier,
        sh.level + 1
    FROM sku_hierarchy sh
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON sh.resolved_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get the final resolved SKUs (non-bundle items)
resolved_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        sh.order_id,
        sh.order_date,
        sh.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        sh.resolved_sku_id,
        sh.order_line_qty * sh.bundle_multiplier AS total_sku_qty
    FROM sku_hierarchy sh
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON sh.resolved_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    -- Need to ensure we only get the deepest level for each path
    -- A resolved SKU is one that doesn't expand further
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM bundle_item bi2 
        JOIN sales_sku ss2 ON bi2.bundle_sku_id = ss2.sku_id
        WHERE ss2.sku_id = sh.resolved_sku_id AND ss2.is_bundle = true
    )
),

-- Actually, let's use a cleaner approach: keep expanding until no more bundles
-- Use a different method: find all leaf SKUs

-- Alternative: use recursive CTE that stops when sku is not a bundle
sku_expansion AS (
    -- Start with order lines
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        ol.sku_id AS current_sku_id,
        ol.line_qty AS qty,
        0 AS level
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand if current is a bundle
    SELECT 
        se.order_id,
        se.order_date,
        se.root_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id AS current_sku_id,
        se.qty * bi.qty AS qty,
        se.level + 1
    FROM sku_expansion se
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON se.current_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get leaf nodes (non-bundle SKUs)
leaf_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        se.order_id,
        se.order_date,
        se.current_sku_id AS sku_id,
        se.qty AS total_qty
    FROM sku_expansion se
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON se.current_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    -- Get maximum level for each root to avoid duplicates from partial expansions
    -- Actually, we need to ensure we only get fully expanded paths
    -- A leaf is reached when it cannot expand further
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM bundle_item bi2 
        JOIN sales_sku ss2 ON bi2.bundle_sku_id = ss2.sku_id
        WHERE ss2.sku_id = se.current_sku_id AND ss2.is_bundle = true
    )
),

-- Get unique leaf paths (avoid duplicates from multiple expansion paths)
-- Actually each path is unique by construction if we track properly
-- Let's use DISTINCT to be safe, or better, use a different approach

-- Get model mappings for leaf SKUs
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.order_id,
        ls.order_date,
        ls.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        ls.total_qty * sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM leaf_skus ls
    JOIN sku_model sm ON ls.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Now explode through model BOM recursively
model_bom_exploded AS (
    -- Base: direct model components
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        mb.component_id,
        sm.model_qty * mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand assembly components
    SELECT 
        mbe.order_id,
        mbe.order_date,
        mbe.model_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        mbe.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
    JOIN component c ON mbe.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= mbe.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR mbe.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum up quantities for the target part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mbe.total_qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM model_bom_exploded mbe
JOIN component c ON mbe.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'LEG-148-WAL-02453'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map directly to models
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier  -- not in a bundle, so multiplier is 1
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN sku_model sm ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        bs.sku_code,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty,
        bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM sales_sku bs
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bs.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku isku ON bi.item_sku_id = isku.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON isku.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE bs.is_bundle = true
),

-- Calculate model units sold per order line
model_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        es.model_id,
        es.model_qty * es.bundle_multiplier * ol.qty AS total_model_units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN expanded_skus es ON l.sku_id = es.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'DE'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
)

SELECT cm.model_code
FROM model_sales ms
JOIN company_model cm ON ms.model_id = cm.model_id
GROUP BY cm.model_id, cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(ms.total_model_units) DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all completed orders in UK in 2024
uk_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.country = 'UK'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Calculate model units for each SKU (non-bundle SKUs directly, bundle items indirectly)
sku_model_units AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: directly mapped to models
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON sm.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items: item SKUs that map to models, multiplied by bundle qty
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty * bi.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku ss_bundle ON bi.bundle_sku_id = ss_bundle.sku_id
    WHERE ss_bundle.is_bundle = TRUE
),

-- Get order lines with their SKUs and model contributions
order_line_models AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        smu.model_id,
        smu.model_qty_per_sku
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sku_model_units smu ON l.sku_id = smu.sku_id
    JOIN uk_orders_2024 uo ON ol.order_id = uo.order_id
),

-- Calculate total model units sold
model_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        olm.model_id,
        SUM(olm.line_qty * olm.model_qty_per_sku) AS total_units
    FROM order_line_models olm
    GROUP BY olm.model_id
)

SELECT cm.model_code
FROM model_sales ms
JOIN company_model cm ON ms.model_id = cm.model_id
ORDER BY ms.total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find store_id for Amazon-DE-01
store_info AS (
    SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-DE-01'
),

-- Get completed orders from Amazon-DE-01 in 2024
completed_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store_info s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),

-- Get order lines with their SKUs, exploding through bundles
-- First, get direct order lines with their SKU info
order_lines_base AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle,
        sk.title
    FROM completed_orders co
    JOIN order_line ol ON co.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
),

-- Explode bundles: for bundle SKUs, get their item SKUs
-- For non-bundle SKUs, keep as-is
exploded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs directly
    SELECT 
        olb.order_id,
        olb.order_date,
        olb.listing_id,
        olb.line_qty,
        olb.sku_id,
        olb.is_bundle,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM order_lines_base olb
    WHERE olb.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to their items
    SELECT 
        olb.order_id,
        olb.order_date,
        olb.listing_id,
        olb.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        false AS is_bundle,
        bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM order_lines_base olb
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON olb.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE olb.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get models for each SKU with quantities
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.order_date,
        es.listing_id,
        es.line_qty,
        es.sku_id,
        es.bundle_multiplier,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM exploded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Calculate total units per model per order line
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        order_date,
        listing_id,
        line_qty * bundle_multiplier * model_qty AS total_model_qty,
        model_id
    FROM sku_models
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode component BOMs
-- Start with model BOMs (components directly used by models)
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base: model BOM entries
    SELECT 
        mu.order_id,
        mu.order_date,
        mu.listing_id,
        mu.total_model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) * mu.total_model_qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM model_units mu
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mu.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= mu.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mu.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: component BOMs for assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.listing_id,
        be.total_model_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * be.total_qty AS total_qty,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN component_bom cb ON be.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= be.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
),

-- Get the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'CAB-856-BLK-00745'
),

-- Filter to only the target part and sum
part_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(be.total_qty) AS total_consumed
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN target_part tp ON be.component_id = tp.component_id
    JOIN component c ON be.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false  -- Ensure it's a part
)

SELECT COALESCE(total_consumed, 0) AS units_consumed FROM part_consumption
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Find the root component for the model
    SELECT 
        c.component_id AS root_component_id,
        c.component_id AS current_component_id,

        bt.root_component_id,
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all SKUs with their model mappings (direct or through bundles)
-- For bundle SKUs, we need to explode to item SKUs, then to models
sku_models AS (
    -- Direct SKU -> model mappings
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty as model_qty,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN sku_model sm ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle items -> their models
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id as sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty * bi.qty as model_qty,
        ss.is_bundle
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON bi.bundle_sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Get completed orders in CA in 2023 with their line quantities
order_lines_2023_ca AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON l.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'CA'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Calculate model units sold: for each order line, find all models and multiply
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        SUM(ol.line_qty * sm.model_qty) as total_units
    FROM order_lines_2023_ca ol
    JOIN sku_models sm ON ol.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    GROUP BY sm.model_id
)

SELECT cm.model_code
FROM model_units mu
JOIN company_model cm ON mu.model_id = cm.model_id
ORDER BY mu.total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
```
