```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs
bundle_expansion AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map to themselves with qty 1
    SELECT 
        sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        1 AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM sales_sku
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        b.bundle_sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sales_sku b ON b.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),

-- Recursive expansion for nested bundles
bundle_expanded AS (
    SELECT * FROM bundle_expansion
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- If an item_sku is itself a bundle, expand further
    SELECT 
        be.root_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        be.bundle_multiplier * bi.qty AS bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_expanded be
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = be.item_sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = be.item_sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get final leaf SKUs (non-bundle items) for each root SKU
leaf_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        root_sku_id,
        item_sku_id,
        bundle_multiplier
    FROM bundle_expanded be
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM sales_sku s 
        WHERE s.sku_id = be.item_sku_id AND s.is_bundle = true
    )
),

-- Map SKUs to models with quantities
sku_models AS (
    -- Direct model mapping for non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        model_id,
        qty AS model_qty
    FROM sku_model
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs mapped through leaf items
    SELECT 
        ls.root_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        ls.bundle_multiplier * sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM leaf_skus ls
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = ls.item_sku_id
),

-- Get completed order lines in JP in 2025 with model quantities
order_model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.model_id,
        ol.qty * sm.model_qty AS total_model_units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sku_models sm ON sm.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
)

SELECT cm.model_code
FROM order_model_units omu
JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = omu.model_id
GROUP BY cm.model_id, cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(omu.total_model_units) DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Find the root component for model AE4-120BLK41-0526
    SELECT 
        c.component_id AS parent_component_id,
        c.component_id AS child_component_id,
        1 AS qty,
        0 AS level
    FROM company_model cm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'AE4-120BLK41-0526'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2024-07-08'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2024-07-08')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand component BOMs
    SELECT 
        bt.child_component_id AS parent_component_id,
        cb.child_component_id,
        bt.qty * cb.qty AS qty,
        bt.level + 1 AS level
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN component_bom cb ON bt.child_component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2024-07-08'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2024-07-08')
      AND bt.level < 100  -- safety limit

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bt.qty), 0) AS total_units
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
model_component AS (
    -- Start with the model's direct components
    SELECT 
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM company_model cm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'CO5-140GRY80-0468'
      AND mb.valid_from <= '2025-10-08'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR '2025-10-08' <= mb.valid_to)
),
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components from model
    SELECT 
        mc.component_id,
        mc.total_qty
    FROM model_component mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id,
        be.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty

)

JOIN component c ON be.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
-- Find the model_id for TE5-180WHT72-0072
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id, model_code
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'TE5-180WHT72-0072'
),

-- Recursive BOM traversal: start from model, go down through components and assemblies

bom_recursive AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the model
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty,
        comp.is_assembly,
        comp.unit_cost
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN target_model tm ON c.parent_code = tm.model_code

    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: children of assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        br.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty,
        comp.is_assembly,
        comp.unit_cost

      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
)

-- Sum costs for all parts (non-assembly components) at any level

FROM bom_recursive
WHERE is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the model_id for the target model
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id, model_code
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'AE4-140GRY68-0456'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: start from model -> components, then follow assembly -> components
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: model directly composed of components
    SELECT 
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        1 AS level
    FROM target_model tm
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'model' AND uc.parent_code = tm.model_code
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE uc.child_kind = 'component'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: assembly components composed of other components
    SELECT 
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        be.level + 1 AS level
    FROM bom_explosion be

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_to_model AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKU -> model edges
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
bundle_to_sku AS (
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU edges
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        c.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
model_to_component AS (
    -- Model -> component edges (top of component hierarchy)
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS model_code,
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
component_hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: direct components from models
    SELECT 
        mc.model_code,
        mc.component_code,
        mc.qty
    FROM model_to_component mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: assembly -> sub-component
    SELECT 
        ch.model_code,
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        ch.qty * c.qty AS qty
    FROM component_hierarchy ch
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = ch.component_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'component'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM component parent 
          WHERE parent.component_code = ch.component_code 
          AND parent.is_assembly = true
      )
),
-- All non-bundle SKUs and their resolved models (direct or through bundle)
non_bundle_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_code FROM sales_sku WHERE is_bundle = false
),
sku_component_paths AS (
    -- Direct non-bundle SKU -> model -> component
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_code,
        ch.component_code
    FROM sku_to_model sm
    JOIN component_hierarchy ch ON ch.model_code = sm.model_code
    
    UNION
    
    -- Bundle item SKU -> model -> component (but we need the non-bundle SKUs that are items in bundles)
    -- Actually, we need non-bundle SKUs that contain the part. A non-bundle SKU can be:
    -- 1. Directly mapped to models
    -- 2. An item inside a bundle (but then it's still a non-bundle SKU itself)
    
    -- The question asks for non-bundle SKUs that contain the part. This includes:
    -- - Direct non-bundle SKUs mapped to models containing the part
    -- - Non-bundle SKUs that are items in bundles (but we count the SKU itself, not the bundle)
    
    -- For non-bundle SKUs that are items in bundles, they still map to models directly
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_code,
        ch.component_code
    FROM sku_to_model sm
    JOIN component_hierarchy ch ON ch.model_code = sm.model_code
    WHERE sm.sku_code IN (
        SELECT item_sku_code FROM bundle_to_sku
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_code) AS sku_count
FROM sku_component_paths
WHERE component_code = 'FAS-535-GRY-01684';
```

```sql
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
```

```sql
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
),

        b.bundle_sku_code,
```

```sql
-- First, find all SKUs and their direct/indirect model mappings with quantities

    -- Direct mapping: non-bundle SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty,
        1 AS path_multiplier  -- direct path, no bundle expansion needed
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
                        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model (recursive expansion of bundles)
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        b.sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        sm.model_qty * bc.qty AS model_qty,
        bc.qty AS path_multiplier
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition bc ON bc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND bc.parent_code = b.sku_code
                         AND bc.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON sm.sku_code = bc.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),

-- Get all completed order lines in 2023 with their SKU and model info
order_sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        stm.model_code,
        stm.model_qty,
        stm.sku_code,
        stm.sku_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sku_to_model stm ON stm.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
)
```

```sql
        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model (recursive through bundle levels)
    SELECT 
        b.parent_code AS sku_code,
        m.model_code,
        b.qty * m.model_qty AS model_qty
    FROM u_composition b
    JOIN sku_to_model m ON b.child_kind = 'sku' AND b.child_code = m.sku_code
    WHERE b.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND b.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= b.valid_to)
),
-- Get unique sku_code to model_code mappings with total quantity (sum over all paths)
sku_model_agg AS (

    FROM sku_to_model
    GROUP BY sku_code, model_code
```

```sql
-- First, find all SKUs that map to the target model (directly or through bundles)

    -- Direct mapping: non-bundle SKU -> model
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        c.qty as sku_model_qty,
        1 as depth,
        s.sku_code as root_sku_code,
        s.sku_id as root_sku_id
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model' AND c.child_code = 'SW8-140BLK02-0002'
        AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle -> item SKU -> model (recursive through bundle contents)
    SELECT 
        child_sku.sku_id,
        child_sku.sku_code,
        c2.qty * sm.sku_model_qty as sku_model_qty,
        sm.depth + 1,
        sm.root_sku_code,
        sm.root_sku_id
    FROM sku_to_model sm
    JOIN u_composition c1 ON c1.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c1.parent_code = sm.sku_code
        AND c1.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND c1.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c1.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c1.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku child_sku ON child_sku.sku_code = c1.child_code
    JOIN u_composition c2 ON c2.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c2.parent_code = child_sku.sku_code
        AND c2.child_kind = 'model' AND c2.child_code = 'SW8-140BLK02-0002'
        AND c2.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c2.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c2.valid_to)
    WHERE child_sku.is_bundle = false
),
-- Get unique SKU to model mappings with total quantity per root SKU
sku_model_mapping AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        root_sku_id,
        root_sku_code,
        sku_id,
        sku_code,
        sku_model_qty
    FROM sku_to_model
),
-- Calculate sales for each root SKU
sku_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        smm.root_sku_id,
        smm.sku_model_qty,
        COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty), 0) as total_sku_sold
    FROM sku_model_mapping smm

    GROUP BY smm.root_sku_id, smm.sku_model_qty

FROM sku_sales;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, find all SKUs that map to the target model, either directly or through bundles
-- We need to trace: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model, or non-bundle SKU -> model

-- Step 1: Find direct SKU -> model mappings for our target model
direct_sku_model AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        1.0 AS model_qty_per_sku  -- direct mapping qty is 1 (or from composition)
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
        AND c.child_code = 'ER2-140GRY79-0370'
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),

-- Step 2: Find bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs which map to our target model
-- We need to trace through the composition hierarchy
sku_hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: all SKUs
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        s.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        s.sku_id AS current_sku_id,
        s.sku_code AS current_sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        1.0 AS qty_multiplier,
        0 AS depth
    FROM sales_sku s
    WHERE s.is_bundle = true  -- Start from bundles
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand bundle contents
    SELECT 
        sh.root_sku_id,
        sh.root_sku_code,
        child_sku.sku_id AS current_sku_id,
        child_sku.sku_code AS current_sku_code,
        child_sku.is_bundle,
        sh.qty_multiplier * c.qty AS qty_multiplier,
        sh.depth + 1
    FROM sku_hierarchy sh
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND c.parent_code = sh.current_sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku child_sku ON child_sku.sku_code = c.child_code
    WHERE sh.depth < 10  -- prevent infinite loops
),

-- Step 3: Find all root SKUs that eventually map to our target model
sku_to_model_paths AS (
    -- Direct mappings
    SELECT 
        dsm.sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        dsm.sku_code AS root_sku_code,
        dsm.model_qty_per_sku AS total_model_qty_per_root_sku,
        false AS is_bundle_path
    FROM direct_sku_model dsm
    WHERE dsm.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle -> item SKU -> model mappings
    SELECT 
        sh.root_sku_id,
        sh.root_sku_code,
        sh.qty_multiplier * COALESCE(dsm.model_qty_per_sku, 1) AS total_model_qty_per_root_sku,
        true AS is_bundle_path
    FROM sku_hierarchy sh
    JOIN direct_sku_model dsm ON dsm.sku_id = sh.current_sku_id
    WHERE sh.root_sku_id != sh.current_sku_id  -- Must have expanded from bundle
)

-- Step 4: Calculate total units sold
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(
        ol.qty * st.total_model_qty_per_root_sku
    ), 0)::INT AS total_units_sold
FROM sku_to_model_paths st
JOIN listing l ON l.sku_id = st.root_sku_id
JOIN order_line ol ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    AND o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND o.order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
```

```sql
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2024-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2024-01-01')
),

-- Step 2: Find bundle SKU -> item SKU edges
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        c.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        c.qty AS item_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2024-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2024-01-01')
),

-- Step 3: Find item SKU -> model edges for our target model (through bundles)
indirect_sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_code AS sku_code,
        sm.model_code,

    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN direct_sku_models sm ON bi.item_sku_code = sm.sku_code
),

-- Combine direct and indirect mappings
all_sku_models AS (
    SELECT sku_code, model_qty FROM direct_sku_models

    SELECT sku_code, model_qty FROM indirect_sku_models
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs (both direct and inside bundles) that map to model VI1-140WHT65-0259
-- We need to expand bundle SKUs to their item SKUs, then find which item SKUs map to the target model

-- Step 1: Get all SKU-to-model mappings (direct and through bundles)
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct SKU -> model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        c.child_code AS model_code,
        c.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model mappings
    SELECT 
        sb.sku_id,
        sb.sku_code,
        sb.is_bundle,
        c2.child_code AS model_code,
        c1.qty * c2.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku sb
    JOIN u_composition c1 ON c1.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c1.parent_code = sb.sku_code
        AND c1.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND c1.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (c1.valid_to IS NULL OR c1.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku si ON si.sku_code = c1.child_code
    JOIN u_composition c2 ON c2.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c2.parent_code = si.sku_code
        AND c2.child_kind = 'model'
        AND c2.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (c2.valid_to IS NULL OR c2.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    WHERE sb.is_bundle = true
),

-- Step 2: Find all SKUs that ultimately map to our target model
target_skus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sku_id, sku_code, model_qty
    FROM sku_to_model
    WHERE model_code = 'VI1-140WHT65-0259'
),

-- Step 3: Get completed orders in 2025
completed_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'completed'
      AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
)

-- Final: Sum units sold
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * ts.model_qty), 0) AS units_sold
FROM order_line ol
JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN target_skus ts ON ts.sku_id = l.sku_id
JOIN completed_orders_2025 co ON co.order_id = ol.order_id;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, find all SKUs (both direct and inside bundles) that map to model AL9-120BLK52-0634
-- We need to trace: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model, and non-bundle SKU -> model

-- Step 1: Find direct SKU -> model mappings
direct_sku_model AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        c.qty as model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model' AND c.child_code = 'AL9-120BLK52-0634'
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
),

-- Step 2: Find bundle SKUs that contain item SKUs that map to the model
-- Need to recursively expand bundles
bundle_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct edges from bundle to item SKU
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id as bundle_sku_id,
        b.sku_code as bundle_sku_code,
        s.sku_id as item_sku_id,
        s.sku_code as item_sku_code,
        c.qty as sku_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_code = c.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
        AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
),

-- Step 3: Map bundle item SKUs to models
bundle_item_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        bc.bundle_sku_id,
        bc.bundle_sku_code,
        bc.item_sku_id,
        bc.item_sku_code,
        bc.sku_qty,
        c.qty as model_qty
    FROM bundle_contents bc
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = bc.item_sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model' AND c.child_code = 'AL9-120BLK52-0634'
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
),

-- Step 4: Combine all SKUs that map to the model with their multipliers
all_model_skus AS (
    -- Direct mappings: sku_qty = 1 (direct sale), model_qty from composition
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        sku_code,
        1 as sku_multiplier,
        model_qty
    FROM direct_sku_model
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle mappings: sku_qty from bundle composition, model_qty from SKU->model
    SELECT 
        bundle_sku_id as sku_id,
        bundle_sku_code as sku_code,
        sku_qty as sku_multiplier,
        model_qty
    FROM bundle_item_to_model
),

-- Step 5: Calculate total model units per order line
order_model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty as line_qty,
        ams.sku_multiplier,
        ams.model_qty,
        ol.qty * ams.sku_multiplier * ams.model_qty as total_model_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN all_model_skus ams ON ams.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_model_units), 0) as total_units_sold
FROM order_model_units
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE

-- First, get all order lines from Wayfair-JP-23 in 2025 with completed orders
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.unit_price,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Wayfair-JP-23'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion
-- We track: the original order line, current item being exploded, its kind/code, and cumulative quantity
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: start from order lines with SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        'sku' AS item_kind,
        ol.sku_code AS item_code,
        ol.order_line_qty AS cumulative_qty,
        0 AS level
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: explode current item through valid composition edges
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_line_qty,
        be.order_date,
        uc.child_kind AS item_kind,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        be.cumulative_qty * uc.qty AS cumulative_qty,
        be.level + 1 AS level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = be.item_kind 
       AND uc.parent_code = be.item_code
       AND uc.valid_from <= be.order_date 
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE be.item_kind IN ('sku', 'model', 'component')
),

-- Get final component consumptions (only leaf components, i.e., parts not assemblies)
-- We need to find components that are parts (is_assembly = false)
-- But we also need to include assemblies that never get further exploded? No, per rules we explode assemblies
-- Actually we need all paths to end at parts. The recursion stops when no more valid edges exist.
-- So we need to filter to rows where item_kind = 'component' and check if it's a part

-- First, get all component rows from the explosion
component_consumptions AS (
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_line_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.item_code AS component_code,
        be.cumulative_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    WHERE be.item_kind = 'component'
),

-- Filter to only parts (is_assembly = false)
part_consumptions AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.order_id,
        cc.line_no,
        cc.order_line_qty,
        cc.order_date,
        cc.component_code,
        cc.cumulative_qty
    FROM component_consumptions cc
    JOIN component c ON cc.component_code = c.component_code
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
)

-- Sum up all consumptions of the specific part
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cumulative_qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM part_consumptions
WHERE component_code = 'CRO-590-WAL-00508';
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        parent_code as sku_code,
        child_code as model_code,
        qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku' AND child_kind = 'model'
      AND valid_from = '1900-01-01' AND valid_to IS NULL
),

-- Model to component compositions (valid on specific date)
model_component_compositions AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_code as model_code,
        child_code as component_code,
        qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'model' AND child_kind = 'component'
),

-- Component to component compositions (BOM, valid on specific date)
component_compositions AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_code as parent_component_code,
        child_code as child_component_code,
        qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'component' AND child_kind = 'component'
),

all_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, sku_code, is_bundle FROM sales_sku

    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        CASE 
            WHEN s.is_bundle THEN sc.child_sku_code
            ELSE s.sku_code
        END as resolved_sku_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN s.is_bundle THEN sc.qty
            ELSE 1
```

```sql
exploded_v2 AS (
    -- Base: order line SKUs with their direct quantity
    SELECT 
        os.order_id,
        os.order_date,
        os.line_no,
        os.order_qty,
        'sku' AS parent_kind,
        os.sku_code AS parent_code,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_multiplier,
        0 AS depth
    FROM order_skus os
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: follow composition edges
    SELECT 
        e.order_id,
        e.order_date,
        e.line_no,
        e.order_qty,
        uc.child_kind AS parent_kind,
        uc.child_code AS parent_code,
        e.qty_multiplier * uc.qty AS qty_multiplier,
        e.depth + 1 AS depth
    FROM exploded_v2 e
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON e.parent_kind = uc.parent_kind 
        AND e.parent_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE e.order_date >= uc.valid_from
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
)

-- Final result: sum quantities for part MOT-228-WAL-00998

FROM exploded_v2 e
JOIN component c ON e.parent_code = c.component_code AND e.parent_kind = 'component'
WHERE c.component_code = 'MOT-228-WAL-00998'
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        uco.listing_id,

        uco.qty * uc.qty AS total_model_qty,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,

      AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case for bundle items: bundle SKU -> item SKU
    SELECT 
        uco.listing_id,
        uco.qty AS order_line_qty,
        uco.qty * uc.qty AS total_model_qty,
        uc.child_code AS sku_code,  -- This is an item SKU, need to continue

    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
                          AND uc.parent_code = uco.sku_code
                          AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE uco.is_bundle = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: item SKU -> model (for bundle items that are now SKUs)
    SELECT 
        stm.listing_id,
        stm.order_line_qty,
        stm.total_model_qty * uc.qty AS total_model_qty,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        stm.depth + 1
    FROM sku_to_models stm
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
                          AND uc.parent_code = stm.model_code  -- This is actually sku_code for intermediate steps
                          AND uc.child_kind = 'model'

    WHERE depth = 1 OR depth = 2  -- depth 1 for direct, depth 2 for bundle->item->model
    GROUP BY model_code

FROM model_sales
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        se.listing_id,

        se.parent_sku_code AS root_sku,
        se.child_kind,
        se.child_code,
        se.comp_qty AS total_qty,
        se.is_bundle
    FROM sku_edges se
    WHERE se.child_kind IS NOT NULL  -- has a composition edge
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand SKU children further, or model->component (but we stop at model)
    SELECT 
        e.listing_id,
        e.line_qty,
        e.root_sku,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        e.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        e.is_bundle
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN u_composition uc

        AND uc.parent_code = e.child_code
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
```

```sql
        se.root_sku_code,
        u.child_kind,
```

```sql
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    WHERE ol.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM jp_orders)

-- Need to recursively resolve bundles to their leaf item SKUs
sku_composition_expanded AS (

    SELECT 
        parent_code AS root_sku_code,
        child_code AS sku_code,
        qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS depth
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku' AND child_kind = 'sku'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: follow bundle -> item SKU -> more item SKUs
    SELECT 
        sce.root_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS sku_code,
        sce.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        sce.depth + 1
    FROM sku_composition_expanded sce
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = sce.sku_code
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
),

-- Get leaf SKUs (non-bundle items) from bundles
bundle_leaf_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        root_sku_code,
        sku_code,
        total_qty
    FROM sku_composition_expanded sce
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM sales_sku sk WHERE sk.sku_code = sce.sku_code AND sk.is_bundle = true
    )
),

-- Resolve all SKUs to their models with quantities
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        sk.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku sk
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = sk.sku_code
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)

        osq.listing_id,
        osq.line_qty,
        stm.model_code,
        osq.line_qty * bls.total_qty * stm.model_qty_per_sku AS total_model_qty
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN bundle_leaf_skus bls ON osq.sku_code = bls.root_sku_code
    JOIN sku_to_model stm ON bls.sku_code = stm.sku_code
    WHERE osq.is_bundle = true
)

FROM model_quantities
```

```sql
        -- SKU edges are always valid (1900-01-01 to NULL)
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE e.is_bundle = true 
       OR e.depth = 0  -- Also expand non-bundle SKUs to models
),

-- Get leaf SKUs that map to models (depth > 0 means we expanded, or is_bundle=false with direct model)
-- For non-bundle SKUs, we need to get their model mapping
sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct model links from SKUs (non-bundle)
    SELECT 
        e.listing_id,
        e.line_qty,
        e.leaf_sku_code,
        e.accumulated_qty AS total_qty,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN u_composition uc
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.parent_code = e.leaf_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE e.depth = 0 AND e.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- From expanded bundles, get model links from leaf SKUs
    SELECT 
        e.listing_id,
        e.line_qty,
        e.leaf_sku_code,
        e.accumulated_qty AS total_qty,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN u_composition uc
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.parent_code = e.leaf_sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE e.depth > 0 AND e.is_bundle = true
),

-- Calculate total model units: line_qty * accumulated_bundle_qty * model_per_sku_qty
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        listing_id,
        line_qty * total_qty * model_qty AS model_unit_qty,
        model_code
    FROM sku_to_model
)

-- Sum and get top 3
SELECT model_code
FROM model_units
GROUP BY model_code
ORDER BY SUM(model_unit_qty) DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'

      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines with their quantities

    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN us_completed_orders uco ON ol.order_id = uco.order_id
),

-- Get SKU quantities sold (listing -> sku)
sku_sales AS (
    SELECT l.sku_id, SUM(ol.qty) AS sku_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    GROUP BY l.sku_id
),

-- Recursive expansion: start from SKUs and expand through composition
-- We need to handle bundles (sku -> sku) and sku -> model, then model -> component, etc.
-- But we want model-level units, so we expand sku -> ... -> model

-- First, get direct sku -> model or sku -> sku (bundle) relationships
-- We'll build a recursive CTE that expands from SKU to models

-- Get all valid composition edges as of 2024-12-31 (any date in 2024 works for SKU edges, 
-- but we need to check validity for model and component edges)
-- Actually for sales we need edges valid at order time, but SKU edges are always valid
-- Model/component edges need validity check. We'll use 2024-12-31 as representative or 
-- we need to join with order date. Let's use order date for strict correctness.

-- Actually, let's re-approach: for each SKU sale, we need to expand to models
-- SKU edges are always valid (1900-01-01 to NULL)
-- For model/component, we need to check validity. Since orders span 2024, let's use
-- a representative date or the actual order date. Using actual order date is complex.
-- Let's use 2024-06-15 as midpoint, or better, let's check that edges are valid for 
-- SOME date in 2024. Actually, let's just use order date by joining back.

-- Simpler approach: get all order lines with their order dates, then expand

order_lines_with_date AS (
    SELECT ol.listing_id, ol.qty, o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'US'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

sku_sales_with_date AS (
    SELECT l.sku_id, ol.qty, ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines_with_date ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),

-- Recursive expansion from SKU to find all reachable models
-- Start: SKU -> child (could be sku for bundle, or model)
sku_to_model_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct sku -> model or sku -> sku
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        s.qty AS root_qty,
        s.order_date,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty AS edge_qty,
        s.qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM sku_sales_with_date s
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = (SELECT sku_code FROM sales_sku WHERE sku_id = s.sku_id)
        AND uc.valid_from <= s.order_date AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR s.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: continue expanding sku -> sku or model -> model (not needed), or model -> component (stop)
    -- Actually we want to reach models. From sku we can reach sku or model.
    -- From sku (bundle item), we can reach model directly.
    -- We don't expand model further for this query.
    SELECT 
        p.root_sku_id,
        p.root_qty,
        p.order_date,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty AS edge_qty,
        p.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM sku_to_model_paths p
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = p.child_kind AND uc.parent_code = p.child_code
        AND uc.valid_from <= p.order_date AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR p.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE p.child_kind = 'sku'  -- Only continue if current node is a SKU (bundle expansion)
),

-- Extract model quantities
model_quantities AS (
    SELECT 
        p.root_sku_id,
        p.child_code AS model_code,
        p.total_qty AS model_units
    FROM sku_to_model_paths p
    WHERE p.child_kind = 'model'
)

-- Sum up and get top 3
SELECT m.model_code
FROM model_quantities m
GROUP BY m.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(m.model_units) DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the model_id for the given model code
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id, model_code
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'ER4-140BLK20-0408'
),

-- Recursive BOM explosion: start from model -> components, then follow assembly -> components
-- We need to find all paths from model to parts (non-assembly components)
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: model -> component (direct children of model)
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        1 AS level
    FROM target_model tm
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'model' AND uc.parent_code = tm.model_code
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = uc.child_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= DATE '2024-03-13' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2024-03-13')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: assembly -> component
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        be.level + 1 AS level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'component' AND uc.parent_code = be.component_code
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = uc.child_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE be.is_assembly = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2024-03-13' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2024-03-13')
)

-- Sum costs for all parts (non-assembly components) with their accumulated quantities
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty_per_unit * unit_cost), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM bom_explosion
WHERE is_assembly = false;
```
